protocol_review.reason: The v1 byte/image estimator shortened the active history at 4.18–7.07 times actual token usage. Three slides occurred during the first trial, whose actual prompt never exceeded 177435 tokens.
protocol_review.mechanical_result_preserved: First trial verified_fail; no model retry within this series.
protocol_review.series_stop: Parent-directed SIGINT after first independent replay completed; remaining planned trials not started as model evaluations.
protocol_review.future_protocol: sqlite-sliding-or-google-count-v2 is separately versioned, still approximate and calibrated, not exact native OpenRouter counting.
